|game_text=Use 1 Force to take ''Stinger'' or ''Virago'' into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Darklighter Spin. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at same system or sector as ''Stinger'' or ''Virago'', opponent may not target those starfighters with weapons for remainder of turn.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Those Rebels Won't Escape Us (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Those Rebels Won't Escape Us (V) (Virtual Set 7)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 2, slip 20 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “Use 1 Force to ▲ Virago or Stinger. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at same system or sector as Virago or Stinger, opponent may not target those starfighters with weapons for remainder of turn. OR Cancel Darklighter Spin.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•20” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf], Internet Archive 5 December 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS7-20-Those_Rebels_Wont_Escape_Us-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 20), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Use 1 Force to take ''Stinger'' or ''Virago'' into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Darklighter Spin. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at same system or sector as ''Stinger'' or ''Virago'', opponent may not target those starfighters with weapons for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
